title: Largest Even Number
summary: Given a string s made up of '1' and '2', remove any characters to form the largest even number possible.
statement: Given a string s made up of '1' and '2', remove any characters to form the largest even number possible. Return an empty string if no even number can be formed.
constraints: s contains only digits one and two.
Delete zero or more characters while preserving order to form the numerically largest even result.
Return an empty string if no even result can be formed.
hints: An even result must end in digit two.
Using the last two permits retaining the longest possible prefix.
Every earlier digit increases digit count and therefore numeric value.
If no two exists, no even subsequence is possible.
editorial: If no two exists, no even subsequence is possible.

tests.explanation: The complete value already ends in two and is the longest possible result.
Keep the prefix through its only two, producing 12.
